measurement.name: source-structural-mccabe-v1
measurement.notClaim: Not a full control-flow graph proof or equivalence to every compiler plugin.
measurement.match: Expanded pattern paths minus one; add conservative unmatched exit unless unconditional wildcard/default exists.
measurement.catch: Same path rule when catch cases are present.
measurement.nestedClosures: Include decisions in owning body; report lambda/partial function separately; do not add closure base twice.
measurement.namedNestedDefinitions: Report separately, no nested body counted twice.
measurement.initialization: Report each primary/object initializer and field independently. Abstract declarations have no executable body.
measurement.nesting: Control constructs only; an else-if continuation retains the enclosing if level.

domain.description: Same full forbidden set as the aggregate-state-controller policy, unchanged; application/infrastructure imports are banned; fixed 5/2 maxima without exceptions. The domain supply carries the event-trigger source type and the completion target event as plain records over the common Id alias — zero akka/strict-runtime imports.

boundary.appliesTo: app/**/application/** and app/**/infrastructure/** and app/net/** (the shared-common supply)
boundary.description: strict-saga-module contract layer: the generated module object projects the strict saga runtime contract (upstream identity constants, technical contracts, per-phase Input/Receipt/binding/port blocks, trigger and completion bridges, definition and behavior) with all codec/contract/identity guards fail-closed. Per the rulings of 2026-11-20 (S1a-prime/O1/N1/Y2/H1) the boundary face admits akka and net.imadz.infra.saga import prefixes as the declared family face — the akka/strict file whitelist (the module file alone) is pinned by structural properties, not by the engine; every other banned prefix (java.io/java.nio/java.time/java.util, scala.collection.mutable, java.sql) stays banned with fully-qualified references as the sanctioned zero-import form. The raw anonymous PhasePort object is rendered as a named private final port class (E1 ruling) because the frozen engine rejects Term.NewAnonymous at every layer; guards, captured binding/codec and per-read re-check semantics are verbatim. Term.Assign is judged by context (E2b ruling); kernel isolation and the direction-aware import policy are unchanged.
forbiddenDelta: Import prefixes akka and net.imadz.infra.saga are admitted in boundary as the declared family face (Y2 continuation ruling, 2026-11-20): structural properties pin the whitelist (akka and strict-runtime imports only in StockTransferSagaModule.scala).

Term.Assign is judged by context, not by layer (E2b ruling): named arguments are admitted in BOTH layers, Term.Assign in any other position is a violation in BOTH layers, and Defn.Var stays banned in both layers.

Direction-aware imports: an application file must not import infrastructure packages (kernel isolation); net.imadz.infra.saga is not an infrastructure path; every other banned import prefix stays banned with fully-qualified references as the sanctioned zero-import form.
stillRejected: assignment targets (Term.Assign outside an argument clause, in both layers)
throw/catch keyword form (the canonical Future.fromTry(Try{...}) companion apply is admitted)
mutable collection names and mutation term names
boundary.exceptions: Exact file/owner/kind with finite maxima and justification. No whole-file exemption or project average.

support.description: No forbidden structural checks; 5/2 default with exact closed-dispatch exceptions. The behavior fixture constructs a local typed ActorSystem over the akka persistence-testkit journal (events ride the real strict-saga protobuf serializer chain), spawns coordinators through the module behavior, and drives full transaction flows with armable probe bindings.
support.exceptions: Exact file/owner/kind with finite maxima and justification.

allow: explicit nominal constructor require for illegal value domain
named private final port classes implementing the runtime PhasePort interface (E1 ruling; all raw guards verbatim)
abstract Host/binding trait obligations with no generated implementation bodies
fully-qualified java.util.UUID references with zero java.*/akka import statements in the module face
plainFpOo.qualification: Syntactic checks do not alone prove semantic purity or OO responsibility. Exact injected implementation and behavior properties are also reviewed.
